title_en: The Coin That Didn't Fall Over
note_en: 又 A 又 B lists two qualities that hold at the same time: 车厢又干净又安静 "the carriage was both clean and quiet." Unlike plain 和 "and," 又…又… stresses that both are true at once, and it usually goes before adjectives. At the end Grandpa sums up with the same pattern: 又快又稳，你们干得好 "fast and smooth — you've done a fine job."
